summary.text: Chris Todd is the Republican state representative for Tennessee House District 73, part of Madison County, who took office in November 2018 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Todd was born on November 26, 1966, and earned a B.S. in biology from Union University.
The legislature's biography lists him as a business owner, with international certification in erosion and sediment control and state certification as a hydrologic professional.
He is a lifetime member of the NRA, a longtime member of the International Erosion Control Association, and a deacon at West Jackson Baptist Church.
Todd has been a member of the House since the 111th General Assembly and serves as Majority Assistant Floor Leader.
He chairs the Agriculture & Natural Resources Committee and is a member of the Calendar & Rules, Judiciary and Transportation committees.
